items.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15
items.q: there where Shield used to live. Remember the Dixieland band, the first Dixieland band?

ctx.x: I tried to get him to learn how to read but it seemed like he could more at ease from here. Yes. And he turned out to be a real good, good class, good jazz class. Yes. And around the corner from there, there where Shield used to live. Remember the Dixieland band, the first Dixieland band? Yes.
